curtains.title: Curtain Care & Size Guide
care: Dry Clean Only for velvet variants
Gentle machine wash (cold) for sheer/net fabric
Do not bleach
Iron on low heat, reverse side
size: 7 ft length fits standard window frames
9 ft length recommended for door/balcony openings
Standard width per panel: 4 ft (extra-wide on request)

bed-double.title: Double Bed Set Care & Size Guide
care: Machine wash cold, separately for first 2 washes
Do not bleach — preserves print vibrancy
Tumble dry low or line dry in shade
Iron on medium heat
size: Elastic-fitted option available on select designs

bed-single.title: Single Bed Set Care & Size Guide
care: Machine wash cold
Do not bleach
Line dry in shade to protect pastel prints
Iron on medium heat
size: Elastic-fitted option adds a secure, wrinkle-free look

towels.title: Towel Care & Size Guide
care: Machine wash warm before first use to boost absorbency
Avoid fabric softener — it reduces GSM fluffiness
Tumble dry low or line dry
Do not iron over embroidered borders

sofa.title: Sofa Cover Care & Size Guide
care: Dry Clean Only for quilted velvet covers
Spot clean spills immediately with a damp cloth
Do not wring or twist the fabric
Steam iron on reverse side only
size: Measure your sofa's widest point before ordering

default.title: Fabric Care & Size Guide
care: Dry Clean recommended for best results
Avoid direct harsh sunlight for long periods
Iron on low-medium heat
size: Message us on WhatsApp for exact measurements before ordering.
